tasks.label: 0. Local — Liberar puertos 3000/8000
args: for port in 3000 8000; do pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$port -sTCP:LISTEN || true); if [ -z "$pids" ]; then echo "Puerto $port libre"; continue; fi; echo "Liberando puerto $port: $pids"; kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; for pid in $pids; do if kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; then echo "Forzando cierre de PID $pid"; kill -9 $pid 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; done
